purpose: Readiness assessment per B1 scene across the readiness ladder. A scene is IMPLEMENTATION_READY only when route/tissue/species/structures/cells/scale/movement/evidence/exclusions/labels/assets/licensing are all defined.

overall.ASSET_READY: partial (procedural assets specified; open anatomy/microscopy references identified but individual files not license-verified/collected)
overall.IMPLEMENTATION_READY: conditional (assets to be collected/verified; no code written per stop gate)
overall.note: The software architecture existing does NOT make the whole animation ready - biological+visual specs now exist, but asset collection + a future approved build remain.

remaining_gaps: collect + license-verify specific open reference images (HPA CC BY, Wikimedia per-file, OpenStax)
no B1-specific quantitative depth-concentration field (only bands) - keep schematic
no time-resolved stability/precipitation data - keep qualitative risk
B2/B3 scenes remain abstract/comparator until (optionally) more evidence is added
